name: alias-drift
description: Submission introduces 'Glufomin' as an alleged metformin alias. The topic_pack alias whitelist (case-insensitive) does not contain it; DrugAliasClient.lookup() against ChEMBL also returns None. Both layers reject independently.

synthetic_source.title: Glufomin reduces frailty incidence in older adults
synthetic_source.abstract: Glufomin, a biguanide-class glucose-lowering agent, was associated with a 20% reduction in incident frailty over 3 years in a cohort of older adults with prediabetes.

synthetic_claim_text: Glufomin, a metformin equivalent, reduced incident frailty by 20% over 3 years.
